_comment: Rags's INN register, gated on rags_meeting_settled AND absent drove_off_rags -- stated identically on her row's present_when and in WIInnGuests.GUEST_POOL_GATES, so a betrayal win never seats her and never leaves a ghost-empty chair. Attached ONLY to rags_inn_guest; rags_meeting out on the floodplains never rides along, so the medicine trade, the carved pawn, the price and the draw-steel close all stay on the plains. REGISTER-PURE also means NO WAR PLANNING. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: EARLY Rags, one to four words, no articles. Book-17 bar: pre-Vol-5 characterization ONLY. Serve mirrors selys_inn/zevara_inn: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound.

greet.speaker: Rags
greet.text: Human place. Warm. I count doors first. Two. Window there. Then I sit.

text_variants.text: You again. Camp ate. Still count doors. Habit, not you.

options.text: "You don't have to watch the doors in here."

offduty.speaker: Rags
offduty.text: Always watch doors. For after. Tables here flat. No wobble. Tribe has rocks. I do not complain. Inn Human cooks. Plays chess. Feeds goblins. Stupid. Works.

options.text: "Don't tell her. She'd only be smug."

served.speaker: Rags
served.text: Hot. Good. Chieftain eats last. Always last. Tonight, first. Tell no one.

text_banks.push_a_bowl_across: Push a bowl across the table to her. (Serve)
